cohort: 260 pregnant and nonpregnant reproductive-aged individuals hospitalized for SARS-CoV-2 infection between 2020 and 2021 at 2 academic referral hospitals.
finding: Pregnant people hospitalized with severe COVID-19 had a low rate of readmission and death over 18 months of follow-up compared to non-pregnant reproductive-aged individuals.
mod_finding: 54% of the pregnant participants delivered by cesarean section.
gest_age: 36 weeks (mean gestational age at COVID-19 diagnosis for pregnant participants)
